remarks:
Fully renovated single-family in Kaisertown — built in the classic Buffalo city footprint, with none of the
maintenance of a century-old home. All-electric with closed-cell spray foam insulation and mini-split
heating/cooling controlled by phone, room by room. New efficient water heater, solar-ready, and a gas line
already run to the basement for future hookup. Composite decking and porch mean zero exterior
maintenance for decades.

Open-concept kitchen, living, and dining area with spacious bedrooms — 3 of 4 with walk-in closets. Just
over a year old with light cosmetic touch-ups; seller will negotiate a paint credit.

Quiet one-way street anchored by a church at the end, minutes from Houghton Park, a 24-hour McDonald's, thruway access, and just 7 minutes to Downtown Buffalo.

 Seller is a licensed real estate agent selling this home directly. Sqft, #BA and #BR has been owner verified.
